description: What each package here is qualified against, and how an unqualified host is refused or disclosed (#11). A range is qualified only because CI installs both of its endpoints from the registry on every push and pull request (range-endpoints, python-range-endpoints) and runs the real-host tests listed under qualifiedBy against them. `npm run compat:check` fails when this record, the package manifests, and CI disagree. Endpoints are the versions the range resolved to on endpointsResolvedAt; `npm run compat:check -- --resolve` re-resolves them.

packages.name: @redact-secret/adapter-pino
lifecycle: hooks.logMethod and hooks.streamWrite on a real pino logger
interleaved async loggers and child loggers sharing one hook
pino.destination (sonic-boom) buffered asynchronous writes
pino.transport worker-thread transport with its own buffering
a destination that throws while echoing its chunk, and one that reports backpressure

packages.name: @redact-secret/adapter-otel
lifecycle: SimpleSpanProcessor and BatchSpanProcessor wrapped by the redacting processor
span name, string and string-array attributes, events, status message, and link attributes
concurrent spans from interleaved async tasks
an exporter that fails through its result callback or by throwing, with SDK diagnostics captured
forceFlush and shutdown forwarding, and spans ended after shutdown

packages.name: @redact-secret/adapter-ai-context
lifecycle: the core's ai-context-boundary conformance fixture, vendored at a pinned core commit, replayed on the real core before and after initialize()
whole-input and incremental equivalence at every chunk partition of every text case
a staged stream: block, limit and callback failure mid-stream, abort, a real AbortSignal, double finalize, append after finalize
every configured limit (whole-input, incremental, traversal) failing closed on the real core
a core that fails to initialize or to load

packages.name: @redact-secret/adapter-mcp
lifecycle: the core's mcp-boundary conformance fixture and runner, vendored at a pinned core commit, replayed through the public API on the real core before and after initialize()
the same fixture carried by real SDK 1.x and 2.x clients and servers over stdio (child process) and Streamable HTTP (127.0.0.1), protocol 2025-06-18 (1.13.0) and 2025-11-25 (1.30.1, 2.0.0, 2.1.0)
opt-in argument sanitation before dispatch: a blocked argument set never reaches the server
server wrappers on the low-level Server and McpServer.registerTool: a throwing handler caught before the SDK converts its message
cancellation over the wire: the host delivers nothing, the server closes its producer and sends no response
a host that logs, persists and builds model context only from the boundary's output, including a real subprocess producer: split, block, limit, cancellation
failing onAudit and onFinding callbacks, a JSON-RPC error, and a core that fails to initialize

packages.name: redact-secret-adapters
lifecycle: logging.Filter on a handler, ahead of the formatter, the cached exc_text, and a second handler
QueueHandler to QueueListener hand-off across threads
concurrent emitters on threads sharing one filtered handler
a handler whose emit fails into logging.handleError
SimpleSpanProcessor and BatchSpanProcessor, concurrent spans from threads
an exporter that fails by result or by raising, with SDK logging captured
force_flush and shutdown forwarding, and spans ended after shutdown

unqualified.how: peerDependencies pino ^10.0.0: npm 7 and later stop with ERESOLVE (checked 2026-09-25 with npm 11.4.1: adapter-pino@0.1.0 with pino@9 fails) unless --legacy-peer-deps or --force overrides it
peerDependencies ^2.0.0: npm 7 and later stop with ERESOLVE (checked 2026-09-25 with npm 11.4.1: adapter-otel@0.1.0 with sdk-trace-base@1 fails) unless --legacy-peer-deps or --force overrides it
peerDependencies ^0.1.0-beta.6 on every npm package: npm 7 and later stop with ERESOLVE

optional peerDependency >=1.13.0 <=1.30.1 on adapter-mcp: when the SDK is installed, npm 7 and later stop with ERESOLVE on a version outside it unless --legacy-peer-deps or --force overrides it. The cap is the highest tested release: a newer one is unqualified until it is added as an endpoint here
optional peerDependencies >=2.0.0 <=2.1.0 on adapter-mcp: npm 7 and later stop with ERESOLVE on a version outside it unless --legacy-peer-deps or --force overrides it
the otel extra requires opentelemetry-sdk>=1.16.0,<2: pip's resolver refuses a conflicting pin (checked 2026-09-25 with pip 26.2.1 and opentelemetry-sdk==1.15.0)
dependency redact-secret>=0.1.0b6,<0.2: pip's resolver refuses a conflicting pin
requires-python >=3.10: pip finds no installable distribution (checked 2026-09-25 for 3.9)
requires-python has no upper bound, so pip installs it; 3.15 and later are not exercised by CI and are unqualified
engines is advisory: npm only warns unless engine-strict is set, so an install succeeds; those runtimes are not exercised by CI and are unqualified

unqualified.host: OpenTelemetry string-array attribute width (JavaScript and Python span processors)
unqualified.how: the span processors apply maxStringLength per element but no element-count bound of their own to a string-array attribute; the SDK's attribute limits are the only bound, so a very wide array costs one scan per element

unqualified.host: MCP SDKs for other languages (the Python mcp SDK included), the HTTP+SSE transport, experimental.tasks and partial results, MCP messages other than tools/call
unqualified.how: packages/adapter-mcp/README.md names them as unsupported; no Python MCP adapter exists, and the boundary acts only on tools/call arguments and results
